text: I can walk through the stages of one HTTPS request and say which ones a reused connection skips.
I can explain the difference between a stateless and a stateful server, with an example of each.
I can choose where to store sessions, carts and uploads, and name the cost of each choice.
I can explain why a stateless app tier makes scaling, deploys and failover simpler.
I can name what becomes stateful once the app tier is stateless, and how to protect it.
